structure: Part 7 read, in full, three feature folders of the high-risk plants linear journey and its parties registry, at repo HEAD 2f2b07fd. consignor-select/ (page.js, fields.js, evaluation.js, controller.js, controller.test.js, consignor-select.fit.spec.js with 10 own tests, copy en/cy/test, view-model index and test) is a thin binding of the shared address-book picker shell at slug consignors/select, role CONSIGNOR, scoped by the consignor obligation. identification-numbers/ (page.js, fields.js, evaluation.js, controller.js, template.njk, controller.test.js, identification-numbers.fit.spec.js with 6 test declarations, three of them looped per commodity type, copy en/cy/test) is a hand-built form of four text inputs, each shown by its own obligation's scope, max 58 characters. consignment-contact-select/ (page.js, fields.js, evaluation.js, controller.js, controller.test.js, consignment-contact-select.fit.spec.js with 11 own tests, copy en/cy/test, view-model index and test) binds the same picker shell at consignment/contact/select with no role and its own return-control words. parties/ (index.js, picked-party.js, picked-party.test.js) registers the three copied-address answers and the copy-on-pick and display rules. Context only, claimed by parts 9 and 12: the picker shell's template.njk, render.js, picker-routes.js and save-selection.js, and obligations/sections/parties.js and contact.js. Since the earlier extract (repo head a88175f2) only the identification-numbers save-failure test changed, from an unavailable backend to a refused backend request; that claim is re-issued under a new id and every other kept claim still says the same thing.
